body:
Real architecture scoping doc, no code changes -- grounds the box/room/world fractal system directly against real existing code (Paper Engine materials/destructibility already exist; PcWorldObjectDef already the real persisted object format; PC_WO_MAX_OBJECTS=8 measured UDP-wire-budget cap resolved into a two-tier structural-vs-destructible object model). Captures every real-time correction from the scoping conversation: SHANKPIT/PAPERCRAFT are siblings sharing tech via hand-porting (not a shared library dependency); SHANKPIT is the actual playable client for PAPERCRAFT-authored geometry even before material-awareness; movement tuning ports FROM SHANKPIT INTO PAPERCRAFT (not the reverse), with an honest caveat that PAPERCRAFT is real server-authoritative/net-native-only while neither codebase has a network-hardened controller proven yet; materials are a real v0 requirement once PAPERCRAFT's own room builder gets built, unlike SHANKPIT's own deliberate v0 texture cut; a real, unresolved question about sharing this tech into GFD's own voxel lineage. Registered as MODULAR-BUILDING-NORTH in EMILY's golden-docs-index. Commit PAPERCRAFT a98ada8.

⚓ ☃
